pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions; pyramiding is limited exclusively to positions currently in +$10.00 floating profit with trailing stops locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution during high-impact expansion wicks; require confirmation of order book imbalance and minimum 1.5 ATR candle closure before entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive partial or full profit harvests at +$15.00 to +$30.00, utilizing trailing dynamic steps to prevent floating profits from evaporating.
